Short title and commencement

ACT VI OF 2004
ACT VI OF 2004
UNIVERSITY OF
SARGODHA (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2004
An Act to amend
the University of Sargodha Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 25th February, 2004]
No.PAP-LEGIS-2(21)/2003/579,
dated 23-2-2004.---The University of Sargodha (Amendment) Bill 2003, having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 8th January, 2004, and
assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 19,th February, 2004, is hereby
published as an act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the University of Sargodha
(Amendment) Act, 2004.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment in section 2 of Ordinance LXXX of 2002

2. Amendment in section 2 of
Ordinance LXXX of 2002.---In the said Ordinance, in section 2, after clause
(p), the following new clause (p-a) shall be added:-
"(p-a) `Pro-Chancellor'
means the Pro-Chancellor of the University; "

3. Amendment in section 9 of
Ordinance LXXX of 2002.---In the said Ordinance, in section 9, after
subsection (6), the following new sub section (7) shall be added:--
"(7) In the
performance of his functions under this Ordinance, the Chancellor shall act and
be bound in the same manner as the Governor of a Province acts and is bound
under Article 105 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
"

Addition of section 11-A in Ordinance LXXX of 2002

[Gazette of

No.PAP-LEGIS-2(21)/2003/579,
dated 23-2-2004.---The University of Sargodha (Amendment) Bill 2003, having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 8th January, 2004, and
assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 19,th February, 2004, is hereby
published as an act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
4. Addition of section 11-A in
Ordinance LXXX of 2002.---In the said Ordinance, after section 11, the
following new section 11-A shall be added: -
"11-A. Pro-Chancellor.---(1)
The Minister for Education, Government of the Punjab, shall be the
Pro-Chancellor, of the, University.
(2) He shall perform such duties
and functions and exercise such powers as may be assigned and delegated to him
by the Chancellor."

5. Amendment in section 20 of
Ordinance LXXX of 2002.----In the said Ordinance, in section 20, subsection
(1)--
(i) in clause (xi), the word
"and" occurring after the semicolon shall be omitted;
(ii) in clause (xii), the full stop
occurring at the end shall be substituted by a semicolon, and thereafter the
word "and" shall be added; and
(iii) after clause (xii), the
following new clause (xiii) shall be added: --
"(xiii) three members of the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab to be nominated by the Speaker of the Assembly."
